general_information.name: OH—MY NAME? IT’S ELEANOR HAYWOOD. I THINK THAT’S THE FULL LEGAL NAME, THE ONE ON DOCUMENTS, YES.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly this low mood that just keeps hanging around, most days, for a long time now… and feeling really not good enough, like I’m sort of waiting for the same thing that happened to my father. He died by suicide when I was twelve, and I keep getting stuck on that, even though I don’t want that for myself.
current_concerns.goals: I want to stop feeling like my father’s death is my future. And… I suppose to feel more steady, more able to be there for my daughter, not carrying this around all the time.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and my father died when I was 12. I don’t know… as a child I was probably just a kid, but that part really changed everything.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed school and a social work degree. I’ve always been serious, or at least that’s how people describe me. It all feels tied up with my father dying when I was 12, honestly.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married — it’s been about 15 years, and it’s current. We have one child.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to break the pattern for my own daughter. And not keep feeling like my father’s death is what my life is heading toward.
